Indian High Courts Address Diverse Legal and Social Issues

Several Indian High Courts have recently issued significant rulings and orders on a range of legal and social matters. These include challenges to reservation policies for converts, protection for individuals facing social boycott or forced marriage, and inquiries into public welfare initiatives. The courts are actively engaging with issues of caste, religion, personal liberty, and public safety.
